17	/**

20	 * 职责：门控（守护中 + 已注册手机号）→ 幂等入队 → 在**独立作用域**取批上传 → 成功删除 / 失败退避记账。

22	 *
23	 * 幂等：本地待发箱以 `(dev_id, time)` 去重，服务端以 `UNIQUE(dev_id, time)` + `INSERT IGNORE` 兜底，
24	 * 因此重试/补传（含超时后服务端其实已入库的情形）不会产生重复数据。

29	    private val api: UploadApi,
30	    private val outbox: UploadOutbox,
31	    private val gate: UploadGate,
32	    private val config: Config = Config(),
33	    private val now: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000 },
34	    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
35	) {
36	
37	    /** 上传接口抽象（生产实现见 [RetrofitUploadApi]；测试可注入伪实现） */
38	    interface UploadApi {
39	        /** @return true 表示 HTTP 2xx（视为成功） */
40	        suspend fun upload(data: SensorUploadData): Boolean
41	    }
42	
43	    /** 门控与身份来源（生产实现见 [PrefsUploadGate]） */
44	    interface UploadGate {
45	        fun guardActive(): Boolean
46	        fun phone(): String
47	        fun gatewayMac(): String
48	    }
49	
50	    /** 上传参数（唯一常量来源） */
51	    data class Config(
52	        val batchLimit: Int = DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMIT,
53	        val initialBackoffSeconds: Long = DEFAULT_INITIAL_BACKOFF_SECONDS,
54	        val maxBackoffSeconds: Long = DEFAULT_MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS,
55	        val maxAttempts: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS
56	    ) {
57	        /** 指数退避：`initial * 2^(attempts-1)`，上限 [maxBackoffSeconds] */
58	        fun backoffSeconds(attempts: Int): Long {
59	            if (attempts <= 1) return initialBackoffSeconds
60	            var seconds = initialBackoffSeconds
61	            repeat(attempts - 1) {
62	                if (seconds >= maxBackoffSeconds) return maxBackoffSeconds
63	                seconds *= 2
64	            }
65	            return seconds.coerceAtMost(maxBackoffSeconds)
66	        }
67	    }
68	
69	    /** 一次上传尝试的结果（用于日志/测试断言） */
70	    data class UploadOutcome(
71	        val attempted: Int,
72	        val uploaded: Int,
73	        val failed: Int,
74	        val skipped: String? = null
75	    )
76	
77	    private val mutex = Mutex()
78	
79	    /** 门控：守护中且已注册手机号；否则不入队、不发起请求（D-09） */

84	     * @return true 表示本次新入队
85	     */
86	    fun enqueueAndUpload(
87	        devId: String,
88	        time: Long,
89	        temperature: Double,
90	        humidity: Double
91	    ): Boolean {
92	        if (!isGateOpen()) {
93	            Log.i(TAG, "upload gated off (guard=${gate.guardActive()}, phoneRegistered=${gate.phone().isNotBlank()})")
94	            return false
95	        }
96	        val enqueued = outbox.enqueue(devId, time, temperature, humidity)
97	        if (!enqueued) {
98	            Log.i(TAG, "duplicate reading ignored by outbox: devId=$devId time=$time")
99	        }
100	        triggerUpload()
101	        return enqueued
102	    }
103	
104	    /** 触发一次上传（入队后 / 每轮 BLE 开始 / 网络恢复 / App 冷启动，见 ITEM-010 接线） */
105	    fun triggerUpload(): Job = scope.launch { uploadPendingOnce() }
106	
107	    /**
108	     * 取一批到期行上传一次（串行，同一时刻不产生并发重复请求）。
109	     * 成功 → 逐行删除；失败 → 逐行 `attempts+1` 并推后退避时间；到 `maxAttempts` 的行保留但不再自动重试。
110	     */
111	    suspend fun uploadPendingOnce(): UploadOutcome {
112	        if (!isGateOpen()) return UploadOutcome(0, 0, 0, "gate_closed")
113	        if (!mutex.tryLock()) return UploadOutcome(0, 0, 0, "busy")
114	        try {
115	            val batch = outbox.dueBatch(config.maxAttempts, config.batchLimit)
116	            if (batch.isEmpty()) return UploadOutcome(0, 0, 0, "empty")
117	
118	            val payload = UploadPayload.build(
119	                phone = gate.phone(),
120	                mac = gate.gatewayMac(),
121	                readings = batch.map { SensorReading(it.devId, it.time, it.temperature, it.humidity) }
122	            ) ?: return UploadOutcome(0, 0, 0, "empty_payload")
123	
124	            val ok = try {
125	                api.upload(payload)
126	            } catch (e: Exception) {
127	                Log.w(TAG, "upload failed: ${e.message}")
128	                false
129	            }
130	
131	            return if (ok) {
132	                batch.forEach { outbox.ack(it) }
133	                Log.i(TAG, "uploaded ${batch.size} reading(s)")
134	                UploadOutcome(batch.size, batch.size, 0)
135	            } else {
136	                batch.forEach { outbox.markFailed(it, config.backoffSeconds(it.attempts + 1)) }
137	                Log.w(TAG, "upload failed for ${batch.size} reading(s); will retry with backoff")
138	                UploadOutcome(batch.size, 0, batch.size, "upload_failed")
139	            }
140	        } finally {
141	            mutex.unlock()
142	        }
143	    }
144

146	        private const val TAG = "CloudUpload"
147	
148	        /** 单批最多上传条数 */
149	        const val DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMIT = 50
150	
151	        /** 首次失败后的退避（秒） */
152	        const val DEFAULT_INITIAL_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 60L
153	
154	        /** 退避上限（秒，30 分钟） */
155	        const val DEFAULT_MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 1800L
156	
157	        /** 最大尝试次数；达到后保留在待发箱但不再自动重试 */
158	        const val DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 20
159	    }
160	}

180	        const val KEY_MAC_ADDR = "mac_addr"
181	    }
182	}

189	            .baseUrl(CloudConfig.HTTP_BASE_URL)
190	            .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
191	            .build()

10	 * 帧长       : 16 * (1 + devCount)
11	 * ```
12	 * 本模块为纯逻辑（不依赖 Android），字节偏移、字节序、符号处理与改动前的
13	 * `MqtttService.parsePlainFrame` 逐位一致；仅把"长度不足/无设备"从抛异常改为

18	    /** 头部块固定长度（字节） */

20

22	    const val DEVICE_BLOCK_SIZE = 16
23	
24	    /** 每设备块中有效载荷长度（字节） */
25	    const val DEVICE_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 8
26	
27	    /** 给定 devCount 时的期望帧长：16 * (1 + devCount) */
28	    fun expectedFrameSize(devCount: Int): Int = HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE * (1 + devCount)
29	
30	    /** 大端无符号 16 bit（高字节在前） */
31	    fun u16be(b: ByteArray, offset: Int): Int =
32	        ((b[offset].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (b[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
33	
34	    /** 大端有符号 16 bit（高字节在前，负温必须保留符号） */
35	    fun s16be(b: ByteArray, offset: Int): Int {
36	        val v = u16be(b, offset)
37	        return if ((v and 0x8000) != 0) v - 0x10000 else v
38	    }
39	
40	    /** 形如 "0C:11:82:24"（大写、冒号分隔），与改动前日志格式一致 */
41	    fun toColonHex(bytes: ByteArray): String =

43

52	        val devIdCompact: String,    // "0C118224"（MacIdBook 键）

59	        /** 明文不足一个头部块 */

61

63	        NO_DEVICE,
64

67

77	        data class Success(
78	            val gatewayIdHex: String,
79	            val devCount: Int,
80	            val samples: List<SensorSample>
81	        ) : Result()
82	
83	        data class Rejected(
84	            val reason: RejectionReason,
85	            val detail: String
86	        ) : Result()
87	    }
88	
89	    /**
90	     * 解码解密后的聚合明文帧。
91	     *
92	     * 成功条件：`size >= 16`、`devCount >= 1`、`size >= 16 * (1 + devCount)`；
93	     * 明文长于期望长度（协议栈读满尾部填充）时按 devCount 取数并忽略尾部。
94	     * 任何不满足条件的情形返回 [Result.Rejected]，不抛异常、不产生读数。
95	     */
96	    fun decodeAggregatedFrame(frame: ByteArray): Result {
97	        if (frame.size < HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE) {
98	            return Result.Rejected(
99	                RejectionReason.FRAME_TOO_SHORT,
100	                "plain=${frame.size}B < header=${HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE}B"
101	            )
102	        }
103	
104	        val devCount = frame[6].toInt() and 0xFF
105	        if (devCount == 0) {
106	            return Result.Rejected(
107	                RejectionReason.NO_DEVICE,
108	                "devCount=0"
109	            )
110	        }
111	
112	        val expected = expectedFrameSize(devCount)
113	        if (frame.size < expected) {
114	            return Result.Rejected(
115	                RejectionReason.LENGTH_MISMATCH,
116	                "plain=${frame.size}B < expected=${expected}B (devCount=$devCount)"
117	            )
118	        }
119	
120	        val gatewayIdHex = toColonHex(frame.copyOfRange(0, 6))
121	        val samples = ArrayList<SensorSample>(devCount)
122	        var off = HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE
123	        repeat(devCount) {
124	            samples += decodeDeviceBlock(frame, off)
125	            off += DEVICE_BLOCK_SIZE
126	        }
127	        return Result.Success(gatewayIdHex, devCount, samples)
128	    }

132	     * 供需要按块复用的调用方使用；不改变字段偏移与换算。
133	     */
134	    fun decodeDeviceBlock(block: ByteArray, offset: Int): SensorSample {
135	        val p8 = block.copyOfRange(offset, offset + DEVICE_PAYLOAD_SIZE)
136	        val devIdBytes = p8.copyOfRange(0, 4)
137	        val humi = u16be(p8, 4) / 10.0
138	        val temp = s16be(p8, 6) / 10.0

141	            devIdHex = toColonHex(devIdBytes),
142	            devIdCompact = toCompactHex(devIdBytes),
143	            humidityPct = humi,
144	            temperatureC = temp

146	    }
